g.text: 1. NMC licence current + scope confirmed (Act 857 — practise only what you're licensed for)
2. HeFRA facility licence (premises inspected + approved BEFORE opening — no shortcuts)
3. Register business (Registrar-General) + GRA tax + district permits + SSNIT for staff
4. NHIS credentialing if claiming (accurate claims only — M05 fraud warning)
5. Protocols + records + referral links + emergency plan (PRO-I M5/M6 apply fully)
6. Insurance (premises + professional indemnity) + waste contract + drug sourcing (FDA)
HOME CARE
post-op, elderly,
chronic, palliative
low capital
CLINIC/PHARMACY*
OPD, ANC, school
health, screening
*licensed premises
TRAIN/CONSULT
BLS, first aid,
QI support, locum
sell expertise
BUSINESS BASICS: plan (service + market + costs + price + break-even) → separate
money (business account, pay yourself a salary) → price honestly (cost + fair margin —
no surprise bills, receipts always) → market ethically (no cure guarantees, no fear ads,
no poaching public patients on duty time — moonlighting theft prosecutes).
IMAGE (the uniform advertises): dress (clean, complete, ID visible), speech (greet,
plain words, no ward slang at patients), conduct (punctual, sober, phone-down at bedside),
social media (PRO-I M6: no patients, no defamation, no ward identifiers — one viral post
ends careers), associations (GRNA + speciality groups: dues, meetings, voice — M05).
Welfare: SSNIT tiers + provident/pensions, insurance, wills, emergency funds (3–6 months)
— nurses counsel planning but skip their own; plan yours first. Burnout shields: leave
taken (not banked), debriefs used, faith/family/friends kept, side-hustles bounded — the
nurse who collapses helps nobody. Retire TO something (teach, consult, farm, rest).
Exam line: \"licence first, books clean, image guarded — enterprise with ethics.\"
